strategies.name: Baseline Sequential All-Reduce Chain
strategies.desc: Performs 8 sequential all-reduce operations with local scale/permute transformations between each. Each all-reduce dispatches the full world*256 tensor. Total 8 dispatches with maximum synchronization overhead but simplest structure. Represents the direct translation of the reference implementation.

strategies.name: Fused Local-Op Batching
strategies.desc: Groups the local permutation and scaling operations to minimize intermediate buffers, potentially using in-place operations where the permutation pattern allows. Still 8 all-reduce dispatches but reduces local compute overhead and memory allocations by pre-computing scale factors and reusing buffers. Trades off code complexity for reduced memory traffic.

strategies.name: Reduce-Scatter + All-Gather Decomposition
strategies.desc: Decomposes each all-reduce into reduce-scatter followed by all-gather, allowing for smaller intermediate payloads (256 elements instead of world*256) during the reduce phase. Results in 16 collective dispatches but each reduce-scatter only communicates 1/W of the data. Favorable when network bandwidth is the bottleneck and latency cost of extra dispatches is acceptable.

strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Level Reduction
strategies.desc: Exploits potential node-level topology by performing intra-node reductions first, then inter-node reductions. With num_nodes parameter, structure 8 rounds of (intra-node all-reduce, inter-node all-reduce) for 16 dispatches total. Reduces cross-node bandwidth by W/nodes factor at cost of additional dispatches, optimized for multi-node deployments.

strategies.name: Pipelined All-Reduce with Chunking
strategies.desc:
Splits the world*256 tensor into chunks and pipelines all-reduce operations across chunks and across the 8 rounds. Issues multiple smaller all-reduce operations that can overlap communication with computation of local transformations. Increases dispatch count significantly (8 * num_chunks) but enables better overlap and reduces per-dispatch latency, trading dispatch overhead for pipeline parallelism.
